name: Rye Bread
description:
A dense rye loaf with a dark crust and a close, slightly sour crumb. It cuts into sturdy slices that hold up beneath cheese or a ladle of gravy.

Sold as one 1 lb rye loaf. Weight includes light disposable wrapping or tying where needed; reusable bags, vessels and drinking water are separate. Partial use is tracked manually.
